seo.title: Hatan Harmag — The Gobi's Living Chain
seo.description: Hatan Harmag connects Gobi genetic resources, nourishing food and regenerative green development.

common.tagline: From the Gobi · Toward a healthier tomorrow

hero.body: A regenerative movement that began with a single berry — protecting the Gobi's rare genetic resources and turning them into nourishing food for everyone.
hero.alt: Harmag berries growing in the Gobi at sunrise

chain.label: Our chain
chain.title: A circle of three steps
chain.intro: Since 2012, Galtuud LLC has protected, cultivated and expanded harmag's genetic resources through a circular development programme.
chain.oneCopy: Safeguard the Gobi's rare genetic resources.
chain.twoCopy: Expand natural reserves through seeds and seedlings.
chain.threeCopy: Turn nourishing food back into investment in nature.
chain.aside: It starts with protection, continues through cultivation, and returns to nature as nourishing food.

products.label: Products
products.title: Grown in the Gobi
products.aside: A small, deliberate range born from research into the Gobi's own resources.

explorer.oneCopy: The core resource, grounded in research into distribution, nutrition and cultivation across Mongolia and Umnugovi.
explorer.twoCopy: Purified water, red cynomorium, liquorice, citric acid and natural sweetener—with no colourants or preservatives.
explorer.threeCopy: Harmag tea, juice, sweets, oil, curds, camel-milk dishes, jelly, sourdough bread and smoothies.
explorer.fourCopy: Preserve seed and gene banks, study rare plants, and expand them through nursery and field cultivation.
explorer.fiveCopy: A project protecting Gobi plants, increasing natural regeneration and developing research-based tourism.

sergeenee.label: One sip · One promise
sergeenee.body: A colourant- and preservative-free drink developed by Hatan Harmag LLC since 2017. Every purchase supports restoration in the Gobi.

story.bodyTitle: Not a fruit. A living system.
story.body1: Harmag (Lycium ruthenicum) is a resilient shrub that holds the Gobi's sand, feeds its soil and connects many lives. Galtuud LLC began studying and protecting its genetic resources in 2012.
story.body2: From research to cultivation, and from cultivation to nourishing food — the circle closes, and the proceeds become investment back into nature.
